text.en:
1. This Order is the Interpretation (Delegations by Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry)) Order 2026 and comes into operation on 16 September 2026.
[S 707/2026 wef 01/10/2026]

2. In this Order, “METI political office holder” means —
(a)any Second Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry;
[S 707/2026 wef 01/10/2026]
(b)any Minister of State assigned by the Prime Minister to assist the Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry); and
[S 707/2026 wef 01/10/2026]
(c)any Parliamentary Secretary assigned by the Prime Minister to assist the Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry).
[S 707/2026 wef 01/10/2026]
[S 707/2026 wef 01/10/2026]

3. The Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry), with the Prime Minister’s approval, delegates the functions under the provisions of the Act specified in the first column of the Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the Schedule.
[S 707/2026 wef 01/10/2026]
4. Revoke the Interpretation (Delegations by Minister for Trade and Industry) Order 2024 (G.N. No. S 140/2024).
